decisions.decision: D-01 (260811-ufu): close the whitespace-blank validation gap on UpdateBoardRequestDTO.name, UpdateTaskRequestDTO.title, UpdateSubtaskRequestDTO.title, SignupRequestDTO.displayName via one reusable @OptionalNotBlank composed constraint (composes @Pattern, no hand-written ConstraintValidator) — not the source todo's proposed per-DTO @AssertTrue (would have keyed violations on method name, not field, degrading the errors.<field> envelope).
